item.text: {"question_id":"8B.10","answer":"By the end of 2023, Lula’s administration had converted parts of its program into enacted law, institutional arrangements, and operating activity, but the supplied evidence does not establish that these changes were yet durable. The record supports enactment or formal restructuring of the sustainable fiscal regime, Bolsa Família and CadÚnico provisions, environmental councils and ministries, cybersecurity policy, and Minha Casa Minha Vida, alongside reported Bolsa Família reach, housing delivery, and preliminary Amazon deforestation reductions (BATCH-0020-E010; BATCH-0019-E005; BATCH-0019-E001; BATCH-0007-E011; BATCH-0017-E007; BATCH-0019-E018; BATCH-0016-E013; BATCH-0001-E019; BATCH-0007-E001). However, these measures were recent, and several were designs, commitments, or government-reported activity rather than demonstrated persistence, compliance, capacity, or outcomes. Environmental councils remained only partly active; Indigenous protection and demarcation were insufficient, with continuing invasions and violence; food insecurity, school exclusion, police killings, prison-system dysfunction, and budgetary-control weaknesses persisted; and the TCU identified serious CadÚnico governance defects (BATCH-0017-E007; BATCH-0005-E022; BATCH-0005-E026; BATCH-0005-E027; BATCH-0001-E020; BATCH-0001-E022; BATCH-0016-E006; BATCH-0018-E009; BATCH-0009-E012; BATCH-0003-E009). The defensible conclusion is therefore mixed and provisional: more of the program had been legally and administratively initiated than at the start, with some early observable progress, but durable conversion across the broader portfolio had not been demonstrated by the end of this one-year period. Attribution is also limited by inherited conditions, legislative and subnational constraints, and the absence of counterfactual or longer-term evidence. Moral approval or disapproval of the program does not affect this execution
